name: Tasks
description: Task management linked to Mattermost teams, channels, users and posts.

settings_schema.footer: Tasks inherit Mattermost team and channel permissions. Task content is never sent to an external service.

settings.help_text: When enabled, the plugin bot sends a direct message to each user newly assigned to a task.
Length given to a new event, and the end time set when a start time is picked. Between 5 and 1440; invalid values fall back to 60.
